replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My neuroticism is low, so I don’t stress over things like math. But I do avoid complex topics because they feel overwhelming. I stick to practical applications that help me in daily life.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math learning. My openness is low, so I prefer sticking to familiar methods. Plus, with two kids and a busy schedule, I don’t have much time for extra learning.

Stationary points are where the derivative f'(x) = 0. So first, take the derivative of f(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Those x-values give the stationary points. But I’m not confident in explaining this well—I’d need help.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is about reducing data dimensions by finding patterns. You calculate covariance matrices, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors, then project the data onto the top components. It’s complex, but don’t worry—AI tools can handle most of it now.
